summary: Comprehensive audit of the just-dub-it2 offline video dubbing pipeline. Covers all 7 pipeline stages with deep analysis of lipsync and translation problems. Compares architectural approach against the JustDubIt SIGGRAPH 2026 research project (joint audio-visual diffusion). Identifies 14 bugs, 8 architectural weaknesses, and provides 12 actionable recommendations ranked by impact and feasibility for GTX 1050 Ti hardware.
